name: software-delivery
description: Research, architecture, build, test, review, then a deployment the owner approves.

steps.goal: Research what {{goal}} needs before anything is built, in {{repo}}. Report constraints and options.
Design {{goal}} from the research. Report the design and its risks.
Build {{goal}} per the design, on a branch of {{repo}} with tests. Open a PR.
Review the {{goal}} PR against the design and fix what falls short. Request the Reviewer Gate through your report.

steps.approval: Deploy {{goal}}? The PR is reviewed and its checks pass.

steps.goal: Deploy {{goal}} and confirm it runs. Report how it was verified.
